access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code; used as a CASTEP alternative.

resources.name: Norm-conserving pseudopotentials for Ti, Si, C, H

access.notes: SSSP library or similar public repository; the agent may also generate them.

Space group P63/mmc, Wyckoff positions: Ti 2a and 4f, Si 2b, C 4f. Lattice constants from literature: a≈3.082 Å, c≈17.605 Å. The structure is fully defined in the public domain and can be constructed from crystallographic data.
